(Usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>)
.²1 Being in or on, situated on; {#tannizWe Pene#}.
.²2 Depending or resting on, referring or relating to; {#tamonizWAH#} <ls>Ms. 12. 95</ls>.
.²3 Devoted or attached to, practising, intent on; {#satyanizWa#}.
.²4 Skilled in.
.²5 Believing in; {#DarmanizWa#}. 6 Conducive to, effecting; {#hemAmBoja#}
 {#srajaste viSada sumahate plozapozAya nizWAH#} <ls>B. R. 5. 51</ls>.

.²1 Position, condition, state; {#tezAM nizWA tu kA kfzRa#} <ls>Bg. 17. 1</ls>;
 {#tezAmaSAntakAmAnAM kA nizWA'vijitAtmanAm#} <ls>Bhāg. 11. 5. 1</ls>.
.²2 Basis, foundation.
.²3 Fixity, fixedness, steadiness; {#mano nizWASUnyaM Bramati ca kimapyAliKati#}
 {#ca#} <ls>Māl. 1. 31</ls>.
.²4 Devotion or application, close attachment.
.²5 Belief, firm adherence, faith; {#SAstrezu nizWA#} <ls>Māl. 3. 11</ls>; {#loke'smin#}
 {#dviviDA nizWA purA proktA mayA'naGa#} <ls>Bg. 3. 3</ls>.
.²6 Excellence, skill, proficiency, perfection.
.²7 Conclusion, end, termination; ({#SfRu#}) {#caritaM pArTivendrasya yaTA#}
 {#nizWAM gataSca saH#} <ls>Mb. 1. 49. 6</ls>; {#atyArUQirBavati mahatAmapyapaBraMSanizWA#}
 <ls>Ś. 4. 3</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>).
.²8 The catastrophe or end of a drama.
.²9 Accomplishment, completion ({#samApti#}); {#pARigrahaRikA mantrA niyataM#}
 {#dAralakzaRam . tezAM nizWA tu vijYeyA vidvadBiH saptame pade ..#} <ls>Ms. 8. 227</ls>.
.²10 The culminating point; {#iyaM ca nizWA niyataM prajAnAm#} <ls>Bu. Ch. 3. 61</ls>.
.²11 Death, destruction, disappearance from the world at the fixed time.
.²12 Fixed or certain knowledge, certainty.
.²13 Begging.
.²14 Suffering, trouble, distress, anxiety.
.²15 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A technical term for the past participial terminations
 {#kta, ktavatu#} ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} {#ta#} and {#tavata#}.)
.²16 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
